name: Solntse na rukave
source:
The adventures that began in [url=/v66458]Strannye prazdniki[/url] are coming to an end... or a new spiral?
The narrative is told from the perspective of a grown-up Ulyanka as she faces completely unexpected consequences of her actions, and now she has to go through trials to find her friend and herself.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3539580862]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[url=/v66458]Strannye prazdniki[/url] 开始的冒险即将结束……还是一个新的螺旋？
故事从成年乌里扬卡的角度讲述，她的行为面临着完全意想不到的后果，现在她必须经历考验才能找到她的朋友和她自己。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3539580862]Steam[/url]]
